narrative.overview: This document records only `blockfield.html` in this directory. The project-root `DESIGN.md` remains the wider brand authority. The shipped page uses its warm black, amber signal, cream text, heavy Inter and square controls in a compact recovery surface. The large particle numeral is a local expression of that world, not a new global pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark background; amber numeral and one filled recovery action.
Heavy uppercase heading and actions; sentence-case explanatory copy.
Square controls and square particles; no card shadows.
Recovery content is independent of decorative canvas rendering.

rules.name: The One Filled Action Rule
rules.body: Only the website recovery action has an amber fill at rest; the server action remains outlined. The decorative amber numeral is not a state.

rules.name: The Case Rule
rules.body: Heading and button labels are uppercase; explanatory prose stays in sentence case. The address keeps its literal spelling in mono.

dos: Do preserve the warm palette, hard corners and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep the recovery heading and links usable without decorative rendering.
Do keep the address mono, literal and selectable, with the launcher explanation nearby.
Do preserve static reduced-motion rendering and the embedded-font license notices.
donts: Don't add a second decorative accent or a shadow lift to recovery controls.
Don't uppercase explanatory paragraphs or use mono for prose.
Don't make the canvas carry recovery instructions or required interactions.
